items.title: Four-Petal Cross Grid DXF Screen for Minimal Privacy Panels
items.description: Simple four-petal flower crosses repeat in a tight, even grid, giving a clean geometric texture with a subtle floral touch. The understated pattern suits minimal privacy screens, window inserts, and modern gate infill.

items.title: Potted Tree of Life DXF Panel for Symbolic Gate Designs

items.title: Isometric Hexagon Cube DXF Pattern for 3D-Effect Panels
